description: Natural language to action ID mapping for all supported games. Canonical names match PREDEFINED_ACTION_MEANINGS exactly (concise English).
notes: canonical must EXACTLY match the value in PREDEFINED_ACTION_MEANINGS for that game
All canonical names use concise English — no Chinese, no verbose descriptions
ALE games: semantic names from human perspective (e.g. 'Accelerate' not 'FIRE' for Enduro)
simple_ids: action IDs shown in simple mode (matches ACTION_SIMPLE_IDS in env_wrapper.py)
variants: alternate names the AI might output (case-insensitive matching)
Matching is done after normalization: lowercase, remove spaces/punctuation
